_notes: DeliveryPolicy v1. Per-target R2 cutover gate: while `cutover` is empty every gate evaluates to today's behavior (uploads proceed, prune deletes exactly as today). A target is cut over only when an entry {target {variant, flavor, platform}, evidence {receiptDigest, qualifiedAt}, preset} is present AND a verified CatalogSnapshot from the exact workflow commit still qualifies the same receipt. Missing current catalog evidence keeps publication enabled. Group closure is computed from iso_groups plus `cutover` (every LIVE + OFFLINE member target cut over). `retained` lists R2 object basenames and sidecars that pruning must preserve.
